You have (if I've got it right) 12 axiom schemata and 4 axioms, so ZFProvable has 2+16 generators.
I couldn't find an explicit list for BZ axioms, I asked on MO.
Amazing project! Given that this is in the deepmind repo, does this mean that PRs can only be merged by deepminders? And thus a potential bottleneck and long wait time?

@Moritz Firsching OK, turns out that in addition to the other axioms (Extensionality, Pairing, Union, Powerset, Infinity, Regularity, [Choice]), having the 10 Gödel operations is equivalent to bounded Separation.
However, two of the Gödel operations are pairing and union, so that's really (I believe) 8 new axioms.

So you can do it with at most 15 axioms, or 14 if you leave out AC, compared to the list in the data for the TM in the repo. Since these no longer include schemata that have to carry an arbitrary first-order formula in the language of set theory, it feels like perhaps the machinery can be reduced? The only cost perhaps is the definition of things like dom of a set.
Someone more expert than me on MathOverflow gave seven axioms to replace the schema of bounded Separation, rather than eight, so then 14 axioms, or 13 without AC.
